integration: Retain upstream authorization scopes and shared Session::admit prechecks; enforce captured channel target before explicit-layer admission and geometric target injection; keep ordinary new-layer transform switching while rejecting implicit commit of isolated channel transforms. Two new engine/UI precheck regressions. Four preview pixel-oracles use upstream photocraft_testkit::gpu_lock so all GPU devices serialize together in the UI suite.
test_scope: Algo, engine, UI and automation; all unit/integration tests plus doctests. Examples compile under all-target Clippy; snapshot and release performance examples built separately.

visual_verification.binary_build: Built from current merge source with cargo build --example snapshot; tracked source clean
visual_verification.fixture: Synthetic RGB8; partial selected Green with Red fixed; affine, Warp, eyes and grouped nudges; selected 3px Green column stretched 30x then bowed
visual_verification.nudge_clock_note: The offscreen driver advances synthetic time between calls; the 10s configured pause covers the five-call fixture. Default pause timing has separate upstream unit tests.
visual_verification.observations: Green alone moves in affine, Warp and grouped nudge previews/commit while Red remains fixed. Hiding Green keeps Warp handles and controls active. One undo restores the configured nudge group to pivot (16,12). A selected 3px Green column scales 30x and its bow persists through full-resolution commit; Red/Blue remain black. Selection outlines follow the transform.
